systems.owner: Social Health Authority; the petition names the private firm Finsprint Limited as managing the HIMS System Utilisation Fee

note: The article describes the HIMS as the platform through which hospitals submit claims to SHA, obtain pre-authorisation and receive reimbursement: billing and administration only, which the typology puts out of scope. It carries the petitioners' claim that a 2 per cent system utilisation fee on about Sh60.7 billion of claims paid to 1 July 2026 gave Finsprint about Sh1.2 billion; no fact of class hmis or emr.
